crm_notes: Lead is SMB B2B support tool; self-serve sign-up followed by ticket reporting latency for EU users.
Customer quote on call: 'EU users are seeing slow replies, median ok but spikes up to 2-3s causing poor UX'.
Logs show median 800ms for short prompts, p95 ~1.8s, p99 ~2.5s when using default region routing to us-central.
Main pain: tail latency + occasional timeouts in frontend (frontend timeout 3s). They set SDK timeout low to avoid blocking UI.
Prompts: large system + user templates (avg 600-900 tokens per request), many repeated instruction tokens — good candidate for prefix caching.
Customer is cost-sensitive; prefers hosted API self-serve but wants clear guidance to avoid overprovisioning and high token costs.

Suggested quick wins shared: choose nearest region (eu-west1) for EU traffic, increase frontend timeout to 8-10s for chat, enable streaming to render tokens asap, limit system prompt size and move constants to cached KV or embeddings.
